decls.name: Thm23FinalBound

paper_span.quote: Set \(\delta=\gamma/(4B)>0\). Since \(n_j\to\infty\), the factor \(1/2\) is absorbed for all sufficiently large \(j\), and

decls.rationale: The final numeric step in the proof of Theorem 2.3: from \(\nu(P_j) \ge \tfrac12 n_j e^{\gamma f_j/2}\) and \(n_j \le e^{Bf_j}\) it derives \(\nu(P_j) \ge n_j^{1+\delta}\) with \(\delta = \gamma/(4B)\), absorbing the factor 1/2 for large j.
